title: Growing
description: Cultivated ingredients begin with variety, timing, soil, light, and the daily attention of a short northern growing season. Calendula is confirmed as farm-grown; other ingredient sources are stated only when the public product record confirms them.

title: Responsible gathering
description: Wild ingredients call for positive identification, permission, a plentiful stand, a light hand, and attention to what the plant and surrounding habitat need to keep going.
caution: Gathering rules vary by land manager. Never treat a plant-identification app as your only source.

title: Sorting & cleaning
description: Leaves, flowers, and fruit are checked, separated, and cleaned in a way appropriate to what comes next. This is where damaged material and field debris leave the batch.

title: Drying
description: Removing moisture concentrates aroma and makes a botanical easier to store and blend. Temperature, airflow, humidity, plant part, and intended use all shape the result.
caution: This is process context, not a shelf-life or home-preservation instruction.

title: Fermenting
description: Microbial activity can shift sharp raw flavors toward tang, depth, and savory complexity. Poor Louis Farms uses fermentation in Fireweed Pu'er, Spruce Tip Hot Sauce, and fermented pepper flakes.
caution: Safe fermentation requires a validated formula and process controls; this site does not provide a recipe.

title: Infusing
description: A chosen oil can carry color and oil-soluble qualities from dried plant material. The current calendula salve description confirms an infused-oil step but does not publish the exact oils or formula.

title: Blending & grinding
description: Texture and proportion turn separate ingredients into a coherent seasoning or sauce. Small adjustments can change heat, aroma, flow, and the way a product lands on food.

title: Small-batch testing
description: A small run creates room to compare texture, aroma, flavor, and handling before a product becomes part of a larger seasonal batch. Experimentation is part of the farm's working character.

title: Bottling
description: Finished sauces are portioned into their sale format and labeled. The current Square listing—not this site—remains the source for bottle size, availability, fulfillment, and purchase options.

title: Packaging & labeling
description: The final container protects the product, makes it practical to use, and carries the details a customer needs. Product photographs here show real current packaging without redesign or alteration.
